Name: Simple Forage Helper
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[b][size=5]Simple Forage Helper[/size][/b]
Spot hidden forage and let the Forage Collector gather it for you each morning!
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*][b]Visible forage markers:[/b] Large indicators highlight loose forage and artifact/seed spots, even behind trees and scenery.[/*]
[*][b]Whole-area collection:[/b] Place a Forage Collector outdoors to gather loose forage and dig spots throughout that location each morning.[/*]
[*][b]Built-in storage:[/b] Open the collector to retrieve your finds.[/*]
[*][b]Automatic chest transfers:[/b] Move collected items into directly adjacent supported chests.[/*]
[*][b]Experience and perks:[/b] Collection uses the owner’s native forage quality, experience, Gatherer and Botanist benefits.[/*]
[*][b]Expanded backpack support:[/b] Works with Simple Backpack Upgrade while keeping the storage menu free of chest previews and colour controls.[/*]
[*][b]12 languages:[/b] Automatically follows your game’s language.[/*]
[*][b]Optional settings:[/b] Toggle forage and dig-spot markers separately. Configure an optional hotkey through Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[/list][heading]Getting the Collector[/heading]
Reach [b]Farming level 10[/b] to receive Marnie’s introduction letter. Buy the Forage Collector at her ranch for [b]25,000g[/b], place it outdoors, and sleep.
Each collector covers its own location for example, one placed at the Beach collects throughout the Beach.
[heading]Requirements[/heading]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.4 or later[/*]
[*]Generic Mod Config Menu  optional[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
Extract the [b]SimpleForageHelper[/b] folder into your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder.
[heading]Notes[/heading]
Collection runs once each morning. Crops, bushes, trees, player-placed items and manually dropped items are excluded. Collection pauses when storage cannot accept more items.
Adjacent chest transfers work without Automate; this is not an Automate network integration.
